post_condition:
Returns a formatted string composed from the 'signature', 'pre_condition', and 'post_condition' fields of the adjacent .spec.json sidecar when that sidecar exists, parses to a JSON dict, and contains all three of those keys with string values. The returned string follows the form '<signature>

Pre-condition:
<pre_condition>

Post-condition:
<post_condition>'. Returns None when the sidecar does not exist, cannot be opened or read as UTF-8 text, contains syntactically invalid JSON, parses to a non-dict JSON value, or lacks any of the three required keys with string values.
